cues: One line turns everything upside down.
The actress knew all along that Alfred was listening.
The letter, the flowers and the lock of hair were exactly what they seemed.
And the comedy she described so well was the comedy she had just performed.
Read it again and the clues were there: her calm, her careful questions, and that curtained door.
